title: It's Not Easy Being Me (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 106bpm walking bass brushed drums resilience true story Australian family honest character portrait
lyrics:
[Intro - country blues acoustic, honest and unhurried]
Joel McIvor.
Forty-five.
Going to bed.
Left a note on the way out:
"The song title of my song would be
it's not easy being me."
Good night bro.

[Verse 1]
First grade rugby in the rear view
Neck on the operating table
Left arm tricep taking its time
Silver Chain every morning for the dressing
Sucker punch from nowhere in the dark
Then the buggy
Jack at the gate
Into the woodpile
Broken leg
Three laughing emojis from hospital
That's the summary so far
It's not easy being me

[Verse 2]
But he goes to work
But he calls on New Year's Eve
But he texts his brother from the hospital
With the laughing faces
But he says Ari will be famous
At midnight
Going to bed
But he rolls two guards off his back
Stands up
Asks the question
But Kerri is there
And the red dust of Zimbabwe
Is in how she stands in a doorway
And that's the best part
Of it not being easy

[Chorus]
It's not easy being me
But I do it anyway
It's not easy being me
Joel Aaron McIvor
It's not easy being me
Forty-five and going
It's not easy being me
Neck surgery and a broken leg
It's not easy being me
Three laughing emojis
It's not easy being me
But who else would do it
It's not easy being me
That all you got, Jack

[Bridge - spoken, Joel's own level warmth]
He named this song himself.
Eight in the morning.
Going to bed.
"The song title of my song would be
it's not easy being me."
Good night bro.
That's the whole biography
in one sentence.
Joel McIvor.
Still kicking.
Named his own song.
Went to bed.

[Verse 3]
He loves his kids with both hands
He loves Kerri like a man who knows
what he found
He calls his big brother when he can
He calls his middle brother from the hospital
Laughing
He calls his dad
And his mum texts first
Because Mum texts first for all of them

[Chorus reprise]
It's not easy being me
But I keep going
It's not easy being me
Joel — little bro — going
It's not easy being me
He named it
He owns it
It's not easy being me

[Outro - guitar alone, warm and settled]
It's not easy being me
Good night bro
It's not easy being me
Love you miss ya
It's not easy being me
Give the kids a cuddle
Kiss on the forehead
From Joel
It's not easy being me
But it's still me
It's still me
